description: This file attaches behaviors for the Drupal Contextual module, managing contextual links, their rendering, positioning, and interactions within the Drupal CMS. It includes functions for adjusting nested links, initializing contextual links, handling AJAX loading, and defining a class for contextual link models.

classes.name: Drupal.contextual.ContextualModelView
classes.description: Models the state and behavior of a contextual link, including rendering, focus, open/close states, and event handling.

methods.name: adjustIfNestedAndOverlapping
methods.description: Adjusts the position of nested and overlapping contextual links to prevent visual collision.

methods.name: initContextual
methods.description: Initializes a contextual link by updating its DOM, setting the destination URL, and creating a model view.
